description: Drop the three `/v1/subscribe/*` operations. The spec documents them as `GET` operations answering `200 application/json`, but they are WebSocket subscriptions ("A WebSocket subscription that broadcasts Protect events"): the server upgrades the connection and streams messages, so a REST call can never read the declared body. A generated REST method would fail at runtime, so none is emitted. Source: the operation summaries and descriptions in the published Protect 7.4.102 OpenAPI document.
